decisions.reason: A black-finish variant of the existing drainage range sits squarely within the firm's design and manufacturing know-how, so early results are easy to interpret and the range can be refined, though its mere mention on the website suggests slightly lower prominence.
A shower channel for seamless coverings is a direct extension of the firm's core competence in barrier-free bathroom drainage, has a dedicated page, and is backed by in-house R&D.

The pump-assisted solution adds some unfamiliar technology, but it builds on the firm's established drainage knowledge, and its own R&D gives it the capacity to assimilate what it learns and improve the product.
A tileable floor drain with grating is close to the core offer, prominently presented, and fits the firm's planning and installation support, so it is very likely to be kept.
A stainless steel design grate uses the firm's own metal manufacturing and design-led positioning, which lets it learn quickly from market feedback, and it has a dedicated page.
